name: Projects & Timesheets
nameTh: โครงการ งาน และ timesheet
description: Projects for service companies, contractors, IT/consulting teams and internal work: budget, members with hourly cost rates, milestones, a task board (todo → doing → review → done) with 'my tasks', and weekly timesheets with submit/approve. Project detail shows progress, hours vs estimate and labour cost vs budget.
